candidates.file: Flag of the British South Africa Company.svg
candidates.text: | || 1891–1924 || Flag of the British South Africa Company || A Union Jack defaced with the emblem of the British South Africa Company in the centre.
| || 1924–1964 || Flag of the United Kingdom || A superimposition of the flags of England and Scotland with the Saint Patrick's Saltire (representing Ireland).
| || 1939–1964 || Flag of Northern Rhodesia (NR is sometimes known as British Congo) || A Blue Ensign with the emblem of Northern Rhodesia.

candidates.file: Flag of the Governor of Northern Rhodesia (1939–1964).svg
candidates.text: | || 1939–1964 || Flag of the Governor of Northern Rhodesia || A Union Jack defaced with the emblem of Northern Rhodesia in the centre.
| || 1953–1964 || Flag of the Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland || A blue ensign with the emblem of the federation.

candidates.file: Flag of the Governor-General of Rhodesia and Nyasaland (1953–1963).svg
candidates.text: | || 1953–1963 || Flag of the governor-general of the Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland || A dark blue flag bearing the royal crest (a lion standing on the Crown), beneath which was the name of the Federation.

candidates.file: Air Force Ensign of the Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland (1953–1963).svg
candidates.text: | || 1953–1963 || Royal Rhodesia Air Force ensign || Azure blue ensign with the Union Flag in the canton and the roundel of the Royal Rhodesian Air Force in the fly.
| || 1963–1964 || Royal Rhodesia Air Force ensign || Azure blue flag with the Union Flag in the canton and the roundel of the Royal Rhodesian Air Force in the fly.
| || 1964–1996 || Flag of Zambia || A dark green field with an orange coloured eagle in flight over a rectangular block of three vertical stripes coloured from to in red, black, and orange. |}

candidates.file: Flag of the President of Zambia.svg
candidates.text: | || 1964–present || Presidential Flag of Zambia || An orange field with the national coat of arms in the centre. |}
| || 1936–present || Flag of Kitwe || A horizontal bicolour of brown with three signs of Venus, and blue with seven wavy white vertical stripes and an eagle. |}
| || 1964–present || Flag of the Zambia Police Service || A blue field with the national flag in the canton and the emblem of the police in the lower fly.
| || 1964–present || Flag of the Zambian Air Force || A light blue field with the Zambia Air Force roundel in the centre.
| || 1964–present || Zambian Civil Air ensign || A light blue field with the Zambia civil air roundel in the centre. |}
